note: Generic kinds of help, each linked to a free public resource: Tele-MANAS (India's national tele mental health programme, run by the Ministry of Health) or the World Health Organization. No company or booking pages. Every summary is our own wording. URLs checked 2026-11-14.

services.name: Talking therapy
services.summary: One-to-one sessions with a counsellor or psychologist, online or in person. Tele-MANAS, India's free government mental health line, is one place to start.

services.name: Seeing a psychiatrist
services.summary: Consultations with a psychiatrist, who can assess and, where needed, prescribe. Tele-MANAS can refer you on to one at no cost.

services.name: Couples therapy
services.summary: Sessions for two partners together, with a therapist who works with couples. A free Tele-MANAS counsellor is one place to start talking it through.

services.name: Self-help guide for stress
services.summary: Short illustrated exercises you can do on your own, a few minutes a day, from the World Health Organization. Free to download.

services.name: Peer support
services.summary: Hearing from and talking with other people going through similar things. If you're not sure where to find a group, Tele-MANAS's free line is one place to ask.

services.name: Free counselling and referral
services.summary: Call 14416 any time to talk to a trained counsellor, who can connect you with a psychologist or psychiatrist. Free, in several Indian languages.
